poll.question: Tomorrow, Cole says the roof needs patching before winter. Maggie watches Sawyer and Finn fading at the salmon, watches you wince at your side. One more good fishing day

options.label: Patch the roof
options.desc: Winter won't wait. Shelter before anything else.

options.label: Back to the creek
options.desc: Rested bodies and full bellies make for stronger hands when it matters.

options.label: Split the day
options.desc: Morning creek, afternoon roof—but they'll all be running on empty.

in_play.label: Fishing trip
in_play.desc: Sawyer teaches, Finn heals, they rest.
